mainEntity.name: How long does it take to see results?

acceptedAnswer.text: Results vary with the treatment type and how your skin responds. Some patients see improvement within weeks, while others need several months.

mainEntity.name: Do skin lightening treatments have side effects?

acceptedAnswer.text: Possible side effects include irritation, redness and sensitivity. Follow the aftercare instructions, and contact your dermatologist if any reaction occurs.

mainEntity.name: How can I maintain my results?

acceptedAnswer.text: Follow a consistent skincare routine and use sunscreen daily to protect against UV damage. Consider maintenance sessions as your dermatologist advises.
